title: Longest Word in Dictionary
summary: Given an array of strings representing an English dictionary, identify the longest word that can be formed by sequentially adding characters to existing words in the array.
statement: Given an array of strings representing an English dictionary, identify the longest word that can be formed by sequentially adding characters to existing words in the array. If multiple words meet this criterion, select the lexicographically smallest one. Return an empty string if no such word exists.
constraints: Every prefix of the returned word must occur; break equal-length ties lexicographically.
hints: A word becomes buildable exactly when its one-character-shorter prefix is buildable.
Process words by increasing length and lexical order.
Seed built with empty; add word when word[:-1] is built; update only for greater length.
Length ordering proves every required predecessor was already considered, and lexical order fixes ties.
editorial: Length ordering proves every required predecessor was already considered, and lexical order fixes ties.
